cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Consensus Means Me
cards.instruction: Treat every partial agreement as confirmation that everyone has accepted your leadership.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You like the blue poster? Those design lessons I gave you worked. I'll tell the volunteers you're happy with me leading the campaign.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like the colour. Can we work on the slogan together?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're ready to contribute under my guidance. That's settled: a collaborative team, with me leading.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let's each write one and let the volunteers choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, you've remembered my audience lesson. I'll authorize that vote. Write 'Your campaign leader invites your views' at the top of the ballot.

reason: Replace the fair-team commentary with a concrete ballot instruction that claims the volunteer vote itself confirms A leadership.
